comments.en:
And one would call to the other,
“Holy, holy, holy!
The LORD of Hosts!
His presence fills all the earth!”
comments.he: וְקָרָ֨א זֶ֤ה אֶל־זֶה֙ וְאָמַ֔ר קָד֧וֹשׁ ׀ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כׇל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃

sections.en: The Congregation says and the Chazzan repeats: We will hallow and revere You as [with] the sweet words of the company of the holy Seraphim who thrice repeat "holy" unto You, as is written by the hand of Your prophet, And they called one to another, and said:
sections.he: קהל וחזן: נַקְדִישָׁךְ וְנַעֲרִיצָךְ כְּנֹֽעַם שִֽׂיחַ סוֹד שַׂרְפֵי קֽוֹדֶשׁ הַמְּשַׁלְּשִׁים לְךָ קְדֻשָּׁה כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ וְקָרָא זֶה אֶל זֶה וְאָמַר:

comments.en:
And one would call to the other,
“Holy, holy, holy!
The LORD of Hosts!
His presence fills all the earth!”
comments.he: וְקָרָ֨א זֶ֤ה אֶל־זֶה֙ וְאָמַ֔ר קָד֧וֹשׁ ׀ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כׇל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃

sections.en: Congregation says and Chazzan repeats: ‘Holy, holy, holy, is Adonoy of Hosts, the fullness of all the earth is His glory.'"
sections.he: קהל וחזן: קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת מְלֹא כָל הָאָֽרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ:

sections.en: The Chazzan says: Those facing them say "Boruch..."

comments.en: Then a spirit carried me away, and behind me I heard a great roaring sound: “Blessed is the Presence of the L<small>ORD</small>, in His place,”
comments.he: וַתִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי ר֔וּחַ וָאֶשְׁמַ֣ע אַחֲרַ֔י ק֖וֹל רַ֣עַשׁ גָּד֑וֹל בָּר֥וּךְ כְּבוֹד־יְהֹוָ֖ה מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃

sections.en: Congregation says and Chazzan repeats: Blessed is the glory of Adonoy from its place
The Chazzan says: And in Your Holy Words it is written:

comments.en:
The LORD shall reign forever,
your God, O Zion, for all generations.
Hallelujah.
comments.he: יִמְלֹ֤ךְ יְהֹוָ֨ה ׀ לְעוֹלָ֗ם אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִ֭יּוֹן לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֗ר הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃ {פ}

sections.en: Congregation says and Chazzan repeats: Adonoy will reign forever; Your God, Zion, throughout all generations! Praise God.
sections.he: קהל וחזן: יִמְלֹךְ יְהֹוָה לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַֽיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר: הַלְלוּיָהּ:
